name: ProgressLegacy
intent: The older 20-tall progress bar with its percent written on or beside it, for screens that still use the legacy look.
usage: Use ProgressLegacy only to match screens built with the older progress bar. It is one component: pass value from 0 to 100 and a label that names what is loading. The percent shows in the middle of the bar, or to its right with labelPosition="right" when the bar is narrow. valueLabel replaces the percent text, like 3 of 12 files. See contracts/progresslegacy.json for the full contract.

label.note: Names the bar for screen readers, like Upload or Account setup.

valueLabel.note: The text shown and read for the value. Defaults to the rounded percent, like 25%.

showLabel.note: Shows the value text. Screen readers still get it when hidden.

labelPosition.note: center writes the value on the bar; right puts it after the bar, for narrow bars.

useWhen: Matching screens that still use the older progress bar: uploads, setup steps, imports with a known percent.
doNot: Do not use it for waits of unknown length. Show a spinner instead.
Do not stack several bars for one process. Use one bar with a clear label.
Do not draw a progress bar from divs. Use this or the kit progress bar.
a11y: role progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin 0 and aria-valuemax 100, named by label.
aria-valuetext is the value text, so a custom valueLabel like 3 of 12 files is read as written.

examples.title: Label in the middle
examples.usage: The percent sits on the bar. At 100 the bar is full.

examples.title: Label on the right
examples.usage: labelPosition right puts the value after the bar, for narrow bars.

examples.title: Custom text
examples.usage: valueLabel replaces the percent. Screen readers read it as written.
